prompt:
Subject: showroom, target meaning "ショールーム".

Composition: Show a polished new car displayed indoors under three simple spotlights, with clean floor reflections and no signs or branding.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Use only attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Thick rounded dark chocolate outlines, simple rounded 2D shapes, clean smooth solid color fills, few restrained flat shadow shapes. No watercolor, grain, mottling, speckles, paper texture, bleed, muddy patches or fuzzy edges. Every person has exactly two naturally attached arms and hands connected naturally to sleeves and shoulders. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows.
OVERRIDE LIGHTING: Show ceiling lamps with small solid cream oval bulbs, but NO light beams, NO rays, NO glows, NO semi-transparent lighting effects. Car on small display platform with short straight solid-color interior wall panel behind to make showroom context. All outer silhouettes must be clean closed smooth dark-brown outlines. No floor reflections. Keep entire scene within canvas.
en: The showroom displays a white car on a platform beneath ceiling lights.
ja: ショールームで白い車が天井の照明の下の台に展示されている。
